common.loadError: Could not load this data. Please try again.
common.actionError: That did not work. Please try again.

visibility.internalHint: Internal: the customer bot will never quote this passage. Only staff tools can use it.

retrieval.title: Retrieval playground
retrieval.description: Ask a question the way a customer would and see which passages the knowledge base returns, how strongly, and how confident the bot would be.
retrieval.queryPlaceholder: For example: can I repay my loan early?
retrieval.thresholdHint: Passages scoring below this are dropped from the results.
retrieval.ex1: Can I repay my loan early?
retrieval.ex2: How much does a gold card cost per year?
retrieval.ex3: What fee do intermediary banks charge on a SWIFT transfer?
retrieval.ex4: How do I block a lost card?
retrieval.ex5: What is the maximum discount an agent can offer on a loan?
retrieval.ex6: What will the weather be like in Batumi tomorrow?

low.title: Why confidence is low
low.empty: The knowledge base has no ready passages yet, so there is nothing to retrieve from.
low.threshold: Every passage scored below the minimum score you set, so nothing was returned. Lower the threshold to see the closest matches.
low.lowScore: Even the best passage scores 0.5 or less. The knowledge base probably does not cover this question, and the bot would hand it to an agent instead of answering.
low.narrow: The best passage is not far enough ahead of the runner-up. Several passages are about equally relevant, so the bot cannot be sure which one answers the question.

retrieval.hitsHint: ranked by score; the tick on each bar is your minimum score
retrieval.noHitsBody: Nothing reached the minimum score. Try rewording the question or lowering the threshold.

quick.title: Quick search
quick.description: A fast keyword lookup across all ready passages, without scoring or confidence.
quick.idle: Type a word or two to search.

duplicates.description: Repeated and near-identical documents make the bot see the same fact twice and can hide an outdated version.
duplicates.noneBody: Every document in the knowledge base is distinct.
duplicates.exactHint: Same text, matched by checksum. The first document in each group is the one to keep.
duplicates.nearHint: Documents that share more than 85% of their wording.
duplicates.confirmBody: "{{title}}" and all of its passages will be removed from the knowledge base. This cannot be undone.

maintenance.exportBody: Download the whole knowledge base as a file for backup or for use elsewhere.
maintenance.jsonHint: JSON keeps documents, tags, metadata and passages together.
maintenance.csvHint: CSV has one row per document, ready for a spreadsheet.
maintenance.reembedBody: Rebuild the search index for every document. Run it after changing the embedding model or when retrieval looks stale.
maintenance.never: No re-embed has been run yet.
maintenance.readOnly: Members can export the knowledge base. Starting a re-embed is limited to owners.

curation.title: KB health
curation.description: Sinji mines conversations for answers the knowledge base got wrong or could not give, and proposes fixes here for you to review.
curation.readOnly: Members can review proposals. Accepting and declining are limited to owners.

pending.title: Nothing to review
pending.body: The knowledge base is keeping up. Run the check to look for new gaps.

accepted.title: No accepted proposals yet
accepted.body: Proposals you accept will be listed here.

declined.title: No declined proposals
declined.body: Proposals you decline will be listed here, with your reason.

curation.bulkHint: Select proposals to accept them together. Removals always need their own confirmation.

bulkConfirm.body: Each change is applied to its document, which is then re-chunked and re-embedded.

S1.name: Bot refusal
S1.meaning: The bot declined to answer because the knowledge base had nothing it could rely on.

S2.name: Weak retrieval
S2.meaning: The bot found only loosely related passages and answered with low confidence.

S3.name: Answer rewritten
S3.meaning: An agent rewrote the AI's suggested answer before sending it. This is the strongest signal.

S4.name: Agent took over
S4.meaning: The bot failed and an agent answered the customer from scratch.

S5.name: Claim not in KB
S5.meaning: A fact-check found a statement that the knowledge base neither supports nor contradicts.

S6.name: KB contradicted
S6.meaning: A fact-check found that what was said conflicts with the knowledge base, which may be outdated.

curation.removeNote: Proposed for removal: this passage is outdated or contradicts newer documents.

edit.title: Accept with edits
edit.description: Adjust the proposed text. It is applied exactly as written below.
edit.label: Text to apply

decline.title: Decline this proposal
decline.description: Say why, so similar proposals are not suggested again.
decline.label: Reason
decline.placeholder: For example: this depends on the processing system and we do not promise it

removeConfirm.title: Remove this document?
removeConfirm.body: "{{title}}" will be deleted from the knowledge base. This cannot be undone.

accepted.add: New document added. It will be ready in a moment.
accepted.update: Document updated and queued for re-embedding.
accepted.remove: Document removed from the knowledge base.

toast.runNone: No new gaps found since the last run
